SYMBOL PAYOUTS

DUEL SCREEN

Starts a duel for a multiplier wild reel.

BOUNTY VAULT

50 LINES. ONE SHOWDOWN.

Matching symbols pay on 50 fixed lines, from left to right starting on the first reel. Three or more matching symbols win. Only the longest match on each line pays. All line wins are added.

THE DUEL WORD AWARD

Spell D–U–E–L on reels 1–4 along any active payline to win 100× the base bet. These must be the actual letters, in order; wilds cannot replace them. An adjacent expanded Duel wild on reel 5 multiplies this award by its value, limited to 5×, for a maximum word award of 500×. Even a 1,024× Duel reel only boosts the word by 5×. Ordinary wilds do not boost it. The highest word award pays once per spin, in addition to ordinary matching-symbol line wins. D, U, E and L also pay as ordinary matching symbols.

DUEL SCREENS & MULTIPLIER WILDS

In the base game and Showdown, a Duel screen participating in a winning combination, including the fifth reel beside a complete DUEL word, expands into a wild reel. Both fighters reveal their own multiplier. The winner’s displayed value becomes the reel multiplier, with no addition or transfer from the loser. A gold Boss reveals a higher starting value. These reels clear after that spin. An unconnected Duel symbol stays in its cell and does not act as a wild.

For ordinary matching-symbol wins, multiplier wilds substitute for all paying symbols. On a winning line, Duel wild reel multipliers add together, then multiply the line payout. Ordinary Crossfire wilds add no multiplier. An all-wild line uses the helmet payout.

SHOWDOWN

10 free spins with more opportunities for one-spin Duel wild reels.

LAST STAND

10 free spins. Duel wild reels start with three lives and stay on their reel. Every spin, the winner keeps its own displayed multiplier. If the current fighter wins, the reel keeps its value and lives. If the challenger wins, its multiplier replaces the previous value and the reel loses one life. The multiplier can increase or decrease. A reel disappears before payouts when its last life is lost.

GOD MODE

10 free spins. One guaranteed immortal 5× Duel wild lands on the first bonus spin. More Duel screens can land on any unoccupied reel, up to five active reels. Duel wild reels always survive and stay in place. Every normal fighter doubles its current multiplier each spin, up to 1,024×. A gold Boss multiplies by the defeated rival’s value instead, with the same 1,024× God Mode cap. Two or more Duel wild reels fire Crossfire shots, creating 2–4 temporary wilds in available ordinary symbol positions.

All duels and Crossfire shots resolve before paying the spin. Duel wild reels cap at 256× in the base game, Showdown and Last Stand; only God Mode has a 1,024× reel cap. The total round win caps at 25,000× the base bet, ending the round immediately.

FEATURE SPINS

Enhanced Spins cost 3× the base bet and give exactly three times the normal chance of triggering a bonus. Super Ante costs 6× the base bet. A bonus lands once in 64 paid spins on average and awards Last Stand or God Mode. Wins use the base bet. Duel Spins cost 50× the base bet and guarantee 2–5 expanded multiplier wild reels on the opening spin, whether or not they connect. Guaranteed wild reels do not guarantee a payout: a matching combination must still follow a payline from reel 1. Both fighters reveal their multipliers and fight before payouts. The winner’s own value is used, without combining it with the loser’s value. When active Duel wild reels occupy both reel 1 and reel 5, they trigger Crossfire after their fights, adding 2–4 temporary wilds to available ordinary positions on the middle reels. Extra Duel reels do not block this feature; a fully wild board has no positions left to change. It can repeat during life respins while both outer Duel reels survive. Reel counts are 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 with probabilities 82% / 16% / 1.9% / 0.1%.

In 1% of Duel Spin rounds, all starting fighters receive three lives. These fighters stay for up to 10 free respins after the opening spin. Each fight keeps the winner’s own multiplier. A challenger victory replaces the current value and removes one life; this can increase or decrease the reel multiplier. A defeated reel disappears before that spin pays. Respins end when all fighters are gone, the 10-respin limit is reached, or the 25,000× round cap is hit. No additional fighters or scatter bonuses land during Duel Spins. Only the opening spin is charged. Duel reel multipliers cap at 256×.

Only one feature spin mode can be active. The coloured BET amount is the full paid-spin cost; payouts and the maximum win always use the base bet shown in this information panel and the shop. Tap DISABLE FEATURE to return to normal spins.

GOLD BOSSES

A Duel screen can reveal a rare gold Boss. In base play, Showdown, Last Stand and Duel Spins, gold Bosses reveal a multiplier from 25× to 250×. A winning Boss keeps that value; a winning challenger uses its own value. Only in God Mode does a Boss multiply its current value by the rival’s value, up to 1,024×. God Mode normal fighters double instead. At least one Boss appears in 1 in 4 Showdown bonuses and 1 in 5 Last Stand or God Mode bonuses on average. These are complete-bonus odds, not a guarantee within any sequence of plays.

BOUNTY VAULT SCATTERS

3 vaults reveal Showdown, 4 reveal Last Stand, and 5 reveal God Mode. After two scatters settle, the remaining reels slow down. Their ordinary symbols dim to black and white while scatters stay in colour. Tap Spin to skip the tease. Bonus purchases reveal their vaults during a reel spin. Mystery Buy costs 250× the base bet and selects Showdown 40%, Last Stand 50% or God Mode 10%.

DUEL SPIN RETURNS

Duel Spins cost 50× the base bet. A payout below that price is a partial return; it is still a net loss for the round.

PROTOTYPE MATH

Payouts use a fixed weighted outcome model. This prototype is for free play.

This first build has not been certified or connected to Stake Engine. Free previews use the same bonus outcome pools, without charging or crediting the balance.
